args.subject: Quick update: sushi-making workshop
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I wanted to share a quick update — I recently attended a sushi-making workshop at the Japanese Cultural Center downtown with my friend Alex. I was especially proud of the spicy tuna roll I made during the class.

Hope you're doing well!

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: The Rustic Kitchen on Oak Street
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I wanted to recommend The Rustic Kitchen on Oak Street — I went there last night with my colleague Lisa. The ambiance is cozy and the food was excellent; I especially loved their signature truffle risotto. If you're looking for a delightful dining experience, it's definitely worth a visit. Let me know if you'd like me to make a reservation.

Best,

args.subject: Weekend trip to the countryside
args.body:
Hi Alice,

Just wanted to share what Sarah and I did on our weekend trip to the countryside: we explored charming little towns, went hiking in the lush forests, and enjoyed a relaxing break away from the city. It was a lovely, restful getaway — I think you'd really like the trails and the cozy cafés we found.

Hope you're doing well!

Best,

args.subject: Weekend in the mountains — stargazing
args.body:
Hi Grace,

During our weekend trip to the mountains, Emily and I went stargazing at night. The skies were clear and it was such a peaceful, memorable experience.

Thought you'd like to hear about it.

Best,

args.subject: I found a new favorite wine — Merlot!
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I wanted to share that at a wine-tasting event last Saturday I discovered a new favorite: a Merlot that I absolutely loved. Thought you might appreciate the recommendation!

Best,
